title: Polygenic dissection of suicidal thoughts and behaviours in high-risk mood-disorder cohorts
title_zh: 高危情绪障碍队列中多基因解析自杀念头与行为
abstract: Abstract Suicidal thoughts and behaviours (STB) span ideation (SI), attempt (SA), and death (SD), yet the factors distinguishing ideation from attempt remain poorly understood. Genome-wide studies suggest shared yet partially distinct genetic liabilities. However, few analyses have tested the differential contributions of SI-, SA-, and SD-related genetic liability across STB phenotypes, particularly in high-risk mood-disorder populations. We analysed up to 17,622 participants from the Australian Genetics of Depression Study and the Australian Genetics of Bipolar Disorder study, jointly modelling polygenic scores (PGS) for SI, SA, and SD across mutually exclusive STB phenotypes using multinomial regression, alongside dimensional outcomes, age of onset, and the ideation-to-attempt transition. SI-PGS and SA-PGS showed independent and distinct associations: SI-PGS showed reduced odds of SI-only but increased odds of SI + SA, and SA-PGS robustly predicted attempt-related outcomes. Transition models captured the clearest clinical signal: SA-PGS predicted a 23% higher odds of attempt among ideators, with absolute risk differences of 9–12% between the top and bottom deciles—larger than those of the onset models (5–7%). Predictive discrimination improved incrementally (ΔAUC ≈ 0.02–0.03; ΔC ≈ 0.01). SD-PGS showed no robust effects. Sex-stratified analyses yielded broadly consistent findings across sexes. These findings support ideation-to-action models at the genetic level, demonstrating partially distinct polygenic liabilities for ideation and attempt. Although absolute predictive utility remains modest, these results indicate that PGS sharpen the stratification of ideators at risk of attempt, providing incremental value for future integrative risk models that combine genetics with mood disorders and environmental predictors.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自杀念头和行为（STB）涵盖了自杀意念（SI）、自杀企图（SA）和自杀死亡（SD），然而区分意念与企图的因素仍知之甚少。全基因组研究表明，存在共享但部分不同的遗传易感性。然而，针对自杀念头、自杀企图和自杀死亡相关遗传易感性在自杀行为表型中的差异化贡献，特别是在高危情绪障碍人群中，尚缺乏分析。我们分析了澳大利亚抑郁基因组研究和双相情感障碍基因组研究中的最高17,622名参与者，使用多项回归模型，在自杀行为的互斥表型以及维度化结局、发病年龄以及自杀意念向企图过渡的过程中，共同模型化自杀意念、自杀企图和自杀死亡的多基因评分（PGS）。SI-PGS和SA-PGS表现出独立且截然不同的关联：SI-PGS表现出降低单一自杀意念的几率，但增加自杀意念+自杀企图的几率；SA-PGS robustly 预测了与自杀企图相关的结果。过渡模型捕捉到了最清晰的临床信号：SA-PGS预测在自杀意识者中企图发生的几率增加23%，在最高和最低十分位组之间的绝对风险差异为9–12%——这比发病年龄模型（5–7%）更大。预测区分度随着增量改进而提高（ΔAUC ≈ 0.02–0.03；ΔC ≈ 0.01）。SD-PGS未表现出显著效应。性别分层分析在两性中均显示出一致的发现。这些发现在遗传水平上支持自杀意念向行动的模型，表现出自杀意念和自杀企图的部分不同的多基因易感性。尽管绝对预测实用性仍然有限，但这些结果表明，多基因评分可以在整合情绪障碍和环境预测因子的未来综合风险模型中，提高对自杀意识者企图风险的分层精度。
